articleTitle: Electricity load forecasting for Urban area using weather forecast information
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The global demand for energy is increasing daily with the expansion of energy infrastructure and the addition of new appliances. Efficient Energy Management System (EMS) is the need of the day. All residential and commercial buildings can achieve better energy efficiency and consumption with the use of EMS. Load forecasting is one of the methods to enable EMS to work efficiently. The accuracy of load forecast depends on many factors. The load forecast model must consider the weather forecast for the region in developing an accurate forecast. This paper develops Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Bagged Regression Trees to generate and predicted load forecast in Urban area using Meteorological data. ANN model is compared with Bagged Regression Trees for prediction accuracy. Good agreement was observed by comparing these results with those available in the literature. It has been observed through analysis that Bagged Regression Trees produce better load prediction for the day ahead load in the urban area.

articleTitle: Optimal energy management strategy for an isolated industrial microgrid using a Modified Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this research paper, a 24-hour ahead optimal energy management system (EMS) for an isolated industrial microgrid containing wind, PV solar, diesel generator, microturbine and energy storage is developed and analyzed. The main goal of the microgrid EMS optimization model is to minimize the cost of energy production, maximize the economical benefit of the energy storage and ensure the renewable energy utilization to the maximum possible extent. The Modified Particle Swarm Optimization (MPSO) technique is proposed to solve the optimization model. The model takes into account the fluctuations of renewable energy resources and load demands within the microgrid and uses appropriate forecasting to overcome these fluctuations. The proposed MPSO-based EMS has been tested on a real microgrid in stand-alone mode (Goldwind Smart Microgrid System, Beijing, China). Simulation results have revealed that the proposed MPSO-based EMS can solve the day-ahead optimization model in acceptable fast computation time efficiently. To validate the performances of the proposed strategy, simulation results were also obtained using Genetic Algorithm (GA). Comparison of simulation results show the robustness of the proposed MPSObased EMS in achieving a possible reduced total energy production cost within a reasonably short computation time.

articleTitle: Short term wind power prediction using ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes an ANFIS based approach for one-day-ahead hourly wind power generation prediction. The increasing penetration of wind energy to electric power generation systems imposes important issues to address resulting from its intermittent and uncertain nature. These challenges necessitate an accurate wind power generation forecasting tool for planning efficient operation of power systems and to ensure reliability of supply. In this paper, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems based approach is used to develop wind power prediction model. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, it is tested based on practical information of wind power generation profile a wind turbine installed at a practical case study microgrid in Beijing. The proposed model is compared with BP neural network based and a hybrid GA-BP NN based models. Evaluation of forecasting performance is made with the persistence forecasting method as a reference model, and results are compared with actual scenario. The proposed approach outperformed both the BP-NN and hybrid models demonstrating its favorable accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Wind turbine blade profile thickness effects on atmospheric ice accretion
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Choice of blade profile (airfoil) is a crucial step in wind turbine design for cold climate operations in order to obtain a competitive performance and to make a tradeoff between aerodynamic performance and structural requirements. A numerical study has been carried out to understand the effects of wind turbine blade profile geometric thickness on resultant ice accretion. Five different blade profiles (airfoils) were used for this study. Based upon the flow field calculations and the super cooled water droplet collision efficiency, rate and shape of accreted ice was simulated for dry ice conditions on each airfoil. Analysis showed a change in airflow and droplet behavior with the blade profile thickness. Results show a decrease in ice growth and thickness at leading edge of the blade profile with the increase of its thickness.

articleTitle: Performance assessment of a solar powered rice husking system with a VFD controlled high capacity 3-phase inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the improvement of technology and economic enhancement, people are now using fuel or grid powered machine for food processing. Among all agricultural crops, rice is the main crop cultivated in Bangladesh and a high efficient processing is required for this. But excessive rise of fuel prices and limitation of power supply to the off grid areas is an obstacle for this sector. Ozone gas emissions for both fuel burning and power generation results in global warming and health issues due to inhalation of the smoke. Because of a good solar irradiation pattern, a solar powered rice husking machine can minimize this burden from the nation. The purpose of this paper is to design and analyse the performance of solar powered rice husking system. Physical demonstration was made by installing 2 kW crystalline PV modules by setting up the rice husking machine with VFD based 3-phase inverter and other measuring equipment in experimental building. Based on maximum solar irradiation, projected output is analysed by using PSIM simulation and the prospect of solar powered rice husking system in Bangladesh is shown with economic feasibility. Based on the experimental data, the performance of the system is also analysed and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Input parameters selection and accuracy enhancement techniques in PV forecasting using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the demand and deployment of renewables get better, there comes a growing interest in improved techniques of forecasting the energy generation from those sources. This paper aims at testing and suggesting techniques for input parameter selection and accuracy enhancement in forecasting power output of a PV system. The PV system under study is an operational system in Goldwind smart microgrid in Beijing, China. Historical records of PV power and weather data are utilized while the forecasting models are based on ANN. The paper starts with studying selection of input parameters through correlation analysis, sets of sensitivity analysis techniques and Garson's algorithm. A combination of these methods was able to pick out the most important parameters in deciding the PV power amount. In order to boost accuracy of forecasting, in addition to the recommended strategic input selection method and searching for optimal size of network, options of output processing were tested. The use of more than one network with different training algorithm and using different types of ANN were investigated with both techniques resulting in enhancement in accuracy of forecast.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic performance degradation due to soiling and characterization of the accumulated dust
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The objective of this study was to determine the daily loss of energy output caused by dust accumulation on photovoltaic (PV) modules, to quantify the dust accumulation rate on PV panels and to determine the physicochemical properties of dust accumulated on PV panels, and their relations to soiling-induced PV performance and environmental conditions. Averaged over the one-year study period, the PV performance loss due to soiling was -0.52% per day for modules cleaned every sixth month, and -0.55% per day for modules cleaned every second month, in terms of a "cleanness index" (CI). The average dust accumulation rate (DAR) was found to be 260±100 mg m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> day<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, with the winter values higher than the summer ones. The DAR was considerably correlated with dust concentration (PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>), wind speed and relative humidity. A substantial negative correlation was also found between daily ΔCl and DAR. On average, very 100 mg m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> dust loading led to a ΔCl of -0.5%. Particle size analysis showed that 90 percent of the dust (by volume) was composed of particles less than 36 μm. The mean and median particle size (by volume) was approximately 18 and 14 μm, respectively. Chemical analysis showed that the dust mainly consisted of calcium, silicon, iron, magnesium and aluminum, and calcite, dolomite, and quartz being the dominant mineral forms in dust accumulated on PV panels.

articleTitle: A hybrid Fuzzy Logic Controller-Firefly Algorithm (FLC-FA) based for MPPT Photovoltaic (PV) system in solar car
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper propose Firefly Algorithm (FA) new method for tuning the membership function of fuzzy logic controller for Maximum Power Point Tracker (MPPT) system Photovoltaic solar car, that consist of hybrid Fuzzy Logic Controller - Firefly Algorithm (FLC-FA) for the parameter. There are many MPPT methods for photovoltaic (PV) system, Perturbation and Observation (PnO), fuzzy logic controller (FLC) standard, and hybrid Fuzzy logic controller firefly algorithm (FLC-FA) is compared in this paper. The proposed FLC-FA algorithm is to obtain the optimal solution for MPPT for photovoltaic (PV) systems for solar cars. The result Fuzzy logic controller firefly (FLC-FA) of the proposed method, the highest maximum strength and efficiency generated is PnO = 96.31%, Standard FLC = 99.88% and Proposed FLC-FA = 99.98%. better than PnO and Fuzzy logic controller standard method. The main advantage of the proposed FLC-FA is more efficient and accurate than the still fuzzy logic controller standard.

Author Keywords: hybrid fuzzy logic controller and firefly algorithm

articleTitle: Demand response control strategy of groups of central air-conditionings for power grid energy saving
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of the national economy and the rapid raise of electricity demand, centralized use of air conditioning loads in cities has become one of important reasons for peak-valley difference increase of grid load in summer, which has led to the imbalance between supply and demand of the energy of China. It is have a certain load potential of central air-conditioning load, therefore, it is of great significance to improve the safe of power grid to adopt a reasonable regulation patterns for the peak clipping of central air-conditioning loads. This paper focuses on researching demand response control strategy with groups of central airconditionings involved, which is aimed at minimizing the building group peak demand. Firstly, the modeling of central air-conditionings equipped in building groups is described. Then, the flexible control methods of air-conditionings are analyzed and the optimization scheme of air-conditionings for power grid regulation is given. Next, a combinatorial regulation model of groups of central air-conditionings for peak load reduction is set up. Finally, case studies are given to carry out performance assessment of the demand response control strategy.

articleTitle: Effects of Q factor on wireless power transmission by magnetic resonant coupling
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper describes the effects of the Q factor on wireless power transmission by magnetic resonant coupling. The Q factor of the antenna for wireless power transmission needs to be as high as possible. In this paper, the effects of the Q factor on transmission power and transmission efficiency is discussed through experiments and simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the corrosion effect of the UHVDC ground electrode current on the metal pipelines
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, with the advantages of long distance and large capacity, ultrahigh voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission projects are developing increasingly in China. Also UHVDC transmission projects share corridors with underground oil & gas pipelines has become increasingly prominent. UHVDC ground electrode influences underground oil & gas pipeline is a new problem in China with rapid development of the electric power and oil-gas industry. When the UHVDC transmission system is working under mono-pole ground return operation mode, a high magnitude ground current will be injected into the soil through the ground electrode. The injected current will cause corrosion effect on the underground metal facilities such as oil & gas pipelines around the UHVDC ground electrode. In this paper, the influence of the ground return current of the UHVDC ground electrode in mono-pole ground return operation mode on the metal pipelines around the UHVDC ground electrode has been studied. The electrolytic corrosion principle of the underground metal pipelines caused by the ground electrode current was discussed. Then several protective measures were elaborated in detail. The research can give useful guideline to the corrosion influence of the UHVDC ground electrode current on the metal pipelines and can provide protective measures for the metal pipelines. It can also be applied in design, planning and site selection periods for new UHVDC ground electrode.

articleTitle: A 1kW synchronous buck converter for solar powered conduction cooking system in off-grid areas of Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Depletion of Natural Gas and increasing price of LPG, burning wood, coal etc, are now the main menaces for cooking purposes in Bangladesh. On the other hand, inefficient burning of wood, charcoal, agricultural wastes and animal dung etc, generate smoke and emits ozone gases. This results in global warming and health issues due to inhalation of the smoke. Because of a good solar irradiation pattern, a solar powered conduction cooker can minimize this burden from the nation. The purpose of this paper is to design, analyse the prospect and performance of solar powered conduction cooking system by using Thin Film photovoltaic modules with a novel synchronous Buck Converter Controller topology. Physical demonstration was made by installing 1 kW Thin Film PV modules on the rooftop of the university building with setting up the conduction cooker and other measuring equipment. 10 panels of 95 Watt are mounted on the rooftop of the university building. Based on solar irradiation data round the year, projected output is analysed by using PSIM simulation and the prospect of solar powered conduction cooker in Bangladesh is shown with economic feasibility. The system was designed and analysed in PROTEUS software and the hardware was fabricated and implemented. Based on the experimental data, the performance of the system is also analysed and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A study of driving cycle for electric cars on Beijing urban and suburban roads
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the driving cycle for electric cars on Beijing urban ways and suburban ways were respectively built. Further, the comprehensive comparison with the world typical driving cycles and in-depth analysis were taken. Firstly, the final driving cycles were obtained by the related data analysis methods after the road experiment by a reasonable scheme. Secondly, the final driving cycles were compared with the European NEDC American FTP75 and Japanese JI0-15 Driving cycles, and were exhaustively analyzed. The result shows the electric cars driving cycle in Beijing has its own characteristics: the mean speed is low, the idle time is rather long, the acceleration and deceleration occurs frequently.

articleTitle: Numerical evaluation of the performance increase for a solar pond with glazed and unglazed
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar pond due to low cost and simple installation has the advantage of not requiring sophisticated technology in heat storage systems. A solar pond consists of three regions and density generally increases towards to the bottom. These zones are named from the surface to the bottom, Upper Convective Zone (UCZ), Non-Convective Zone (NCZ) and Heat Storage Zone (HSZ). It is necessary to minimize heat losses to improve the performance of solar pond and heat loss generally happens over the surfaces. In this study, cover design with glazed to minimize heat lost from the solar pond are numerically conducted to degrease heat loss caused by the evaporation and precipitation and obtained design are compared with experimental study to understand simulation accuracy of this study. As a result, it is seen that there is significant increases in the performance of the pond by selecting the appropriate cover.

articleTitle: Optimized LCR output filter of APF based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The active power filter (APF) which uses the pulse width modulation (PWM) technology brings switching harmonics in that is high-frequency current. These harmonics must be eliminated by the output filter between APF and grid. Due to the superior filtering properties of LCR while the impedance is fluctuating in grid, the LCR filter is widely employed. Therefore, the model in mathematical expression of LCR type output filter between the grid and APF is constructed. On the basis of above researches, and synthetically considering the compensating and filtering performances of the system etc, the optimized model of LCR filter and approach based on genetic algorithm are proposed. Finally, the simulation shows that the LCR filter mentioned above has excellent properties.

articleTitle: Effectiveness analysis of determining the main harmonic source by harmonic active power direction method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Nowadays, harmonic active power direction method is the most widely applied method to judge the main harmonic source, but the power direction method is theoretically different from harmonic current superposition principle. In this paper, it has been got that the power direction method and harmonic current superposition principle are different through mathematical analysis, and the precise conditions which make harmonic active power direction method right has been got. On the basis of this, this paper analyzes the applicable area of the harmonic active power direction method. In practical engineering applications, this method does not require the exact values of the harmonic impedances of the two sides. Besides, the easy way to judge the location of the main harmonic source is obtained in this paper, which only depends on the measured angle value of the harmonic voltage and harmonic current at the PCC. It is convenient to the practical application in engineering.

articleTitle: Design of a dynamic voltage restorer with cascade inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a DVR system using the cascade inverter to perform an effective compensation for the voltage sag. By splitting the DVR-injected active and reactive power from different inverter unit, the designated dynamic voltage restorer not only provides the battery a ripple-free dc link to extend the lifetime of battery, but also offer a flexible way to design the capacitor bank in the system realization. This method has been tested through computer simulation and hardware validation. Test results help consolidate the feasibility of the approach for the applications considered.

articleTitle: High voltage ride-through control method for DFIG-based wind turbines based on Resonant Controller
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the transient process of a DFIG based wind turbine in detail during general grid voltage swell conditions, especially the symmetrical voltage swell cases. And the key points influencing the turbines' high voltage ridethrough (HVRT) capability is then evaluated. Furthermore, a HVRT control scheme, based on the resonant control, is put forward, which can meet the grid codes' reactive current requirement. Both the simulation and experimental results show that the proposed control scheme can accelerate the attenuation of the dc and negative sequence stator fluxes, and thus reduce the fluctuations in the active/reactive power, the electromagnetic torque and the dc link voltage. As a result, a smooth HVRT process can be obtained, which is meaningful to the turbines' safety.

articleTitle: Novel current-tracking control for hybrid active power filter with injection circuit and its engineering application
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A novel type hybrid active power filter with injection circuit (IHAPF) is proposed. The passive filter of this system can be used for reactive power compensation as well as for harmonic mitigation. The active power filter does not bear fundamental voltage any more. A new sliding-window iterative algorithm based on discrete fourier transform (SWIDFT) is proposed for detecting harmonic current. Recursive integral PI regulator (RIPI) is adopted in current closed-loop controller and this control method can eliminate steady-state error. Fuzzy algorithm is used to adjust the coefficients of RIPI online. Results of industrial application show that the proposed control and detection methods in this paper can meet the requirement of IHAPF controller. After IHAPF with the proposed controller is run, the total harmonic distortion (THD) of supply current is reduced to 1.8% from 41.8 % and the power factor of the system is increased to 0.95 from 0.55.

articleTitle: Research on charging and discharging control strategy of electric vehicles and its economic benefit in microgrid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the concept of the microgrid and the hierarchical partition dispatch is proposed, and electric vehicles as new elements will be included in the microgrid and its economic dispatch control, the load model and economic benefit of electric vehicles have become a hot research topic. Firstly, considering the characteristics of electric vehicles, two kinds of charging and discharging strategies were formulated, and corresponding load model of two strategies were established. After that, an microgrid economic dispatch model with electric vehicles and new energy is established, and the priority method is used to solve it. Finally, a case is carried out to study the economic dispatch problem of a renewable microgrid with electric vehicles. The study shows that the priority method can effectively solve the economic dispatch problem of the microgrid, and it can improve the economic benefit of the microgrid to apply orderly charging and discharging control.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of electric heat storage boiler based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to attain "peak load shifting", the main problem is to solve operational optimal control of heat storage boiler in this paper. Making the electric heat storage boiler the main object of the thesis, considering constraints of electric heat storage boilers such as heat storage capacity, power and temperature, etc., the control strategy of electric heat storage boiler based on multi-agent is proposed through incorporating the ideas of multi-agent. With simulating the heating system of the electric heat storage boilers and regarding a single electric heat-storage boiler as a single-agent, the load demand model of electric heat storage boiler is built and multiple electric boilers can communicate and coordinate mutually, thus the optimization control of electric heat storage boiler is realized. Simulation for a specific case is conducted, and the results indicate that the proposed control strategy based on multiagent can effectively achieve "peak load shifting" by the electric heating units, reducing the difference between peak and valley.

articleTitle: Security constrained economic dispatch with dynamic thermal rating technology integration
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In traditional model for security constrained economic dispatch (SCED) decision, the limit on power transfer capability of overhead transmission line (OTL) is represented by its static thermal rating (STR) which incurs conservative constraints on OTLs' transfer limits which definitely causes conservative decision results. Comparing with STR, dynamic thermal rating (DTR) is an effective technique to improve the ampacity of OTL based on the monitoring of real-time environmental conditions including ambient temperature, solar radiation, wind speed and direction. Aiming to the issue mentioned above, in this paper, a SCED implementation framework is first designed with DTR technology integration, after that, on basis of the historical data gathered by DTR, a forecasting approach for thermal rating is proposed. Predict the environmental conditions along the overhead line using the exponential smoothing method first and then the forecasting of the DTR can be obtained. Then the benefits that delivered by utilizing the forecast thermal rating in SCED is analyzed via case studies. This paper explores an application pattern of DTR technology in SCED. It is capable of enhancing the power system security and economic performances by exploiting the potential transfer capability of OTLs.

articleTitle: Voltage-based hot-spot detection method for PV string using projector
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a voltage-based hot-spot detection method for PV string using projector. Hot-spots form in solar cells at defects causing high carrier recombination rate, it appears as high reverse leakage current of p-n junction when solar cells are partial shadowed. Using this characteristic, authors previously developed a Voltage-based hot-spot detection method to quickly identify and characterize the severity of module hot-spot. The validity of this method has been confirmed. However, previous experimental results were show for just one module. In this paper, experiments are done on plural modules in string. From the result, this method works effectively for PV string. It provides the possibility of hot-spot inspection after modules are installed.

articleTitle: Energy conservation opportunities in institutional buildings - a case study in India
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy consumption is an important aspect with respect to operating costs of buildings. Modern buildings are being designed considering their energy performance and carbon footprints. However, there is scope to reduce the energy consumption and carbon footprints in existing old buildings by suitable retrofitting. A case study is discussed where in the energy audit of an academic institution in northern India revealed several opportunities where energy consumption can be reduced considerably. This paper presents the analysis to achieve about 35% reduction in energy consumption and around 177 tons reduction in carbon footprint in an institutional building, National Institute of Technical Teachers Training & Research in Chandigarh, India. It recommends measures that can be implemented with moderate investments and payback period. Another important feature is the utilization of roof-tops of institute building to install solar PV power plants apart from retrofitting measures. Presently 7% energy requirement is being met through installed solar PV power plant on the rooftop of institute building. After installing such power plants at all the roof-tops of building about 25% of energy needs can be met by solar energy source.

articleTitle: Cascaded PD-PI controller for active power frequency control of two-area multi-units power system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In interconnected multi-area power system; the real power generation within each area has to be managed through active power frequency control considering scheduled power exchange. In this work, two different controllers, namely cascaded PD-PI and conventional PID controller are considered for analyzing the dynamic response of the two area interconnected power system. Area-I consists of two reheat type thermal generating power plant units and area-2 comprises of two non-reheat type thermal power plant units. The controller gains of PD-PI and PID controllers are efficiently tuned by 'Teaching Learning based Optimization Technique'. In area-I, 1% step load disturbance is applied for analyzing the dynamic performance of the proposed controllers. It is being observed that the cascaded PD-PI controller performs better than the other one in many aspects.

articleTitle: Frequency response technique to recognize turn-to-turn insulation deterioration in transformer winding
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: One of the most important failure issues in transformers is the turn-to-turn short circuit fault. Turn-to-turn fault can be occurred due to the inter-turn paper insulation deterioration, or due to removing thin layer coated insulation between the winding turns. To date, there is no specific pre-determined method to find (or at least suspect) a deteriorated turn-to-turn insulation medium before catastrophic failure. Frequency Response Analysis (FRA) as a method introduced for transformer mechanical defect recognition, may be able to recognize the turn-to-turn fault potential and assist on this case. Hence, this study has concentrated practically on FRA capability to find turn-toturn insulation degradation as well as inter-turn aging rate. To this end, two different test objects are used and FRA signatures in various conditions are recorded. FRA results are provided and technically discussed.

articleTitle: The bad data estimation based on the Current Reckoning Method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Current Reckoning Method is carried out in the paper, which adopts the link branch reckoning technology based on the measuring current information to achieve data digging and realize identification of bad data in the measurements set, and can identify bad data in the node injection measurement as well. Final, carry out analysis and verifying based on the modular system, which has a certain of application value in the engineering.

articleTitle: Three-phase imbalance prediction: A hazard-based method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Three-phase power systems are widely used in highpower applications and they are designed to operate in a near-balanced fashion at a nominal frequency for optimal performance. Although a slight voltage imbalance is tolerant in real-life scenarios, a significant three-phase imbalance has detrimental effects for power delivery and even damages many key components in a power system. Therefore, how to prevent or reduce the three-phase imbalance has become a critical issue in smart grids. In this paper, we attempt to address this challenge by introducing a hazard-based model to predict the three-phase imbalance based on historical status data. Firstly, we model the three-phase imbalance as a probability event and thus formalize the three-phase imbalance prediction problem as a time-dependent classification problem. Secondly, we introduce the feature extraction method and present the hazard-based prediction model. Experimental results on a realworld dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization method of multi energy interconnected microgrid configuration and operation based on lifecycle cost
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To solve the problem of the low return on investment in the traditional micro grid, multi energy interconnected micro grid were constituted by distributed photovoltaic, gas turbine, combined cooling heating and power supply system (CCHP). Because power generation of distributed photovoltaic has uncertainty and the load of cold, hot and electricity is unbalance, the optimizesion of microsource configuration and its operation must be made. The method of the genetic algorithms and linear programming is used to solve these. This optimize method was verified by MW-levels comprehensive community which the results show that the multi energy interconnected microgrid has economy and promotion value under the current price system and the condition of Comprehensive community.

articleTitle: A smart power saver based on composite switch and self-learning fuzzy control for drinking water dispenser
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A smart power saver based on composite switch and self-learning fuzzy control for drinking water dispenser is developed in order to solve some problems existing in drinking water dispenser widely used in offices and homes, such as wasting power energy and producing 'thousands of boiling water'. A single-chip microcomputer is used as CPU and self-learning fuzzy control is adopted as control strategy to reduce ineffective heating of drinking water dispenser. In order to improve power saving effect, some low consumption designs of power saver is proposed. Composite switches and buzzer warning circuit designed are also proposed to reduce conduction loss. In addition, the power saver has multiple operation modes so that it can be applied to different requirements of the occasion. The experimental data shows that power saving effect of the power saver is significant, and it is worth to be further popularized.

articleTitle: Research on position detection technology of high voltage circuit breaker motor mechanism
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Rotor position detection and signal conditioning circuit of brushless DC motor are designed for the special applications of high voltage circuit breaker motor mechanism. First, high voltage circuit breaker brushless DC motor mechanism and brushless DC motor rotor position detection technology were introduced in brief. Then we analyzed the speed requirements of high-voltage circuit breaker opening and closing operation at all stages. Finally, according to the ideal opening and closing operation speed characteristic curve of the given 40.5 kV vacuum circuit breaker short-circuit state motor, we designed motor position detection circuit, voltage conversion circuit and communications circuit. Voltage conversion circuit testing system is established. Experimental results show that the designed circuit meeting the requirements of circuit breaker operating.

articleTitle: A new noise-immune method to detect protective CT saturation and its release instants
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: CT saturation is a phenomenon that can cause inaccurate fault current measurement and may result in related protective relay failure to block the high current flow under a fault condition in a power system. Hence, it is required to develop a method to detect occurrence of CT saturation with a good accuracy under presence of noise in a power system. In this paper, a new method having the afore-mentioned characteristics is presented. The main benefit of exploiting the introduced approach here for detecting CT saturation is its high level of reliability as well as its reasonable operational speed in CT saturation detection. In other words, these two properties are implemented to this method. Moreover, in addition to the conventional assumption in the past works to consider the fault current as the sum of one sinusoidal current component, and an exponential current component; it is assumed here that the fault current can also be in form of a double-exponential waveform as it is observed in some switching fault currents even if the lightning fault currents which preserve a very short duration are ignored. This is a new assumption which seems has not been analyzed in the past published works. In this paper first the existing CT saturation detection methods are classified, and then the new method with its formulation is presented. Finally this method is compared with some of the past published works through some simulations.

articleTitle: Fast and selective protection technology in low voltage distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Because of the limited information interaction between protective electrical apparatuses in different distribution levels, rapidity and global selectivity are difficult to achieve concurrently in short-circuit fault protection. Based on short-circuit fault early detection, a fast and selective protection technology in low voltage distribution systems was presented, in which the effective interaction of short-circuit fault information between fault detection modules and central control module could be achieved through CAN bus communication. The overall protection scheme was illustrated, then short-circuit fault early detection method and its key role in fast and selective protection was analyzed, and the flexible and reliable selective protection mechanism based on CAN bus was designed. Finally the scheme was applied in simulated short-circuit fault selective protection experiments to test the completion time of selective protection and observe detailed interaction processes. The results show that the selective protection technology combining fault early detection and CAN bus communication can find the fault level fast and accurately, and give a breaking command to the relevant protective electrical apparatus reliably, which contributes to the fast and global selective protection in low voltage distribution systems.

articleTitle: The study on advanced Three-pulse harmonic model of twelve-pulse converter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to design DC filters reasonably and effectively, an accurate harmonic model of converter need to be established. Since 3-pulse harmonic model can only be applied in symmetrical system without considering the effect of background harmonics, the model is not accurate enough to be used in HVDC transmission project. For above reasons, this paper proposes an advanced 3-pulse harmonic model which can apply in the asymmetric system. The advanced model has the same topology as 3-pulse harmonic model, but the influence on asymmetric factors and background harmonics of 3-pulse harmonic voltage source and 3-pulse inductance are taken into account. Finally, taking Three Gorges-Changzhou HVDC transmission project as an example, through the compare of simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC demonstrate the correctness of the advanced 3-pulse harmonic model.

articleTitle: Long-term scheduling with the consideration of interruptible load
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the case of electric power demand exceeds supply, the emergent direct load control measures may cause negative society influence and significant economic loss. In this paper, the demand side management is converted from emergency control to long-term coordination. Long-term hydro-thermal scheduling model considering interruptibe load is established to fully excavate the regulation ability of demand side. To make the model more realistic, constraints relating to reservoir operation, coal-fired plan and maintenance scheduling are formulated in the proposed scheduling model. Furthermore, different time index variables are set to meet various demands of time interval for electric power and energy. The case studies are carried out on a system with 58 thermal units and 44 hydropower units. Results show that the economy of the system is improved, power generation and consumption resources are integrated in the long-term scheduling.

articleTitle: Case study of grid connected PV plant feeding power to electrical submersible pumps
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A 10MW PV (Photo Voltaic) plant, synchronized with grid, connected to a distribution substation that feeds power to electrical submersible pumps in oil field is chosen for grid system studies. Studies such as Load Flow study, Short Circuit study, Transient Stability study, Harmonics study, Relay setting studies were carried out as part of the PV installation project to verify technical feasibility of PV plant operation and to identify technical issues related to grid synchronism. The study incorporates the specific requirements of utility undertaking for grid operation. Results of various system studies are listed in the conclusions. From the studies, in general it appeared that Load Flow, Short Circuit and Transient stability, Relay coordination studies did not pose any electrical risks. Harmonics related measurements will have to be carried out after commissioning to check and confirm the validity of results of harmonic model of the grid study.

articleTitle: Optimal load shedding management for ensuring power system stability
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power system stability is necessary for the secure system operation. Transient instability is regarded as most challenging stability problem for most of the systems; therefore it is of much concern for power system stability. In this paper the power system stability problem has been addressed by reducing transients using a load shedding scheme. A relay coordination scheme is proposed based on under-voltage/over-current to shed the less priority load in an interconnected transmission network. The proposed analysis is performed on IEEE standard system and Utility network in ETAP environment. The result shows that proposed approach has a potential to improve power system stability.

articleTitle: Impact of electric potential due to faulted overhead ground wire on distribution system equipment
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of electric potential (EP) due to faulted overhead ground wire (OHGW) on distribution system equipment. The fault current injection to direct OHGW, which may cause insulation failure to electrical equipment, was simulated using the current distribution electromagnetic interference grounding and soil structure (CDEGS). Three cases were investigated on a 115/22 kV substation and a 22 kV distribution of provincial electricity authority (PEA): 1) the existing system, 2) bonding between the ground grid substation and the ground rod located in earth under the riser pole, and 3) the OHGW of the take-off located in the substation and the OHGW of the riser pole are connected. It can be confirmed from the study results that bonding between the ground grid substation and the ground rod located in the earth under the riser pole offers an effective means to help decrease the EP between the OHGW and the ground, therefore reducing the risk of equipment damage.

articleTitle: Solar powered railway track monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to increased railway accidents, we propose to install a camera on the face of the train to monitor the railway track up to 2Kms at all times. We also plan to install LCD screens in every coach, which displays the live screening of the camera. This will make sure that at all times some passenger on the train can monitor the tracks. This whole system will be powered by solar energy harnessed using solar panels mounted on the train top. They will track the Maximum Power Point (MPP) of the solar array and the power generated will be stored in Li-ion batteries. This power is utilized during the absence of sun and its output voltage is regulated using DC/DC converters according to the energy needs of the camera, Wi-Fi and LCD.

articleTitle: The recovery of lithium cobalt oxides from spent Li-ion batteries and its electrochemical performances
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This work focused on the recycling and reuse of LiCoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, which comes from spent Li-ion batteries. Recycled cathode materials powders were successively obtained by discharging, manual dismantling and scrapping procedure. Then, ball-milling was carried out to lower the reunion of recycled powders. During ball-milling process, a certain amount of LiOH·H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O was added in recycled powders to compensate the loss of Lithium. Finally, the calcinations of recycled powder was conducted under different temperatures, including 500°C, 600 °C, 700°C, 800 °C and 900°C for 2 hours. The structures of recycled samples were investigated by X-ray diffraction and the results show that the calcinations temperature has significant impact on the structure of LiCoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The charge/discharge performances of recycled powders were studied. The recycled LiCoO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> calcined at 800 °C presents superior electrochemical performances, which has initial discharge capacity of 121.8 mA·h/g. The discharge capacity could still keep at 120.5 rnA·h/g after 30 cycles, with only 1.1 % capacity loss rate.

articleTitle: Brushless DC motor speed control system Simulink simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: According to the mathematical model of a brushless DC motor, using MATLAB / Simulink to build various independent functional modules, and integrated into the simulation model of brush less DC motor control system. The system uses the double loop of control mode , including the inner current loop and the outer speed loop, to ensure that the motor is performance well in the high and low speed, and system has start fast, flexible control, robustness and other advantages. By conducting the two simulation experiments of tracking the speed and keeping the speed stability, we preliminarily verify the effectiveness and reasonable of the system modeling method and the feasibility of the control system design, simulation and setting parameters can also be made to optimize the actual controller control and commissioning reference.

articleTitle: Construction method of green power index model in regional power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, with thermal power generation dominating China's power industry, the green development of regional power grid has been a major concern. As the power supply side is the source of the power grid pollution, in order to achieve the sustainable development of power grid, an index model is built to measure the effect of green development in the power supply side of the different regional power grid. By monitoring the pollutant discharge value of the power supply side in a period of time, combined with the environment value of the different pollutants and the amount of electricity of regional power grid in a monitoring period, a model of the green power index is constructed in regional power grid. This model is introduced to evaluate the green development in the power supply side of the regional power grid. The results show that the index can reflect the green development effect of the power supply side of the regional power grid effectively.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic transient modeling and simulation of large-scale HVDC power grid with all primary devices
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: An electromagnetic transient simulation model of 500 kV HVDC Power Networks in Hubei province is established. According to the actual configuration and parameters, all the primary electrical devices in 500 kV AC/DC hybrid power grids are modeled in detail, including HVDC converter, AC/DC transformers, AC/DC breakers, filters, reactors, transmission lines, grounding polar, and all the other power elements. Hypersim is used to model the whole power grid and calculate the electromagnetic transients. Three actual cases in terms of AC no-load lines switching overvoltage, HVDC commutation failure caused by single phase short-circuit fault, and the current distribution between GRTS (ground return transfer switch) and MRTB (metallic return transfer breaker) are analyzed by using the proposed model. Compared to the field measured of voltage and current, the reliability of simulation models is verified.

articleTitle: The research on the dynamic lubricating control system of wind turbine's main bearings
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The existing automatic lubrication system of the wind turbines is prone to producing the condition of less lubrication or over lubrication, which is very harmful to the bearing's work state and life period. In this thesis, a dynamic lubrication theory is brought forward. Based on practical operation condition, it can provide the necessary supply of bearing lubricating oil according to a scheme of dynamic lubrication control strategy. Firstly, the defects of traditional lubrication methods are pointed out, and the advantages of dynamic lubrication methods are compared. So the basic idea of dynamic lubrication theory is introduced. Secondly, the factors which determine the lubrication scheme are analyzed, and an appropriate control strategy is selected out according to the main influencing factors. Using adaptive filtering prediction method based on time series, this scheme can calculate the lubrication requirements of the main bearings, which is founded on the real-time operation data of wind turbine power output, turbines' load, and so on. Finally, the parameters of lubrication control point are obtained by using this lubricating algorithm on MATALB. Laboratory physical verification is also carried out using these parameters and the results show that the dynamic lubrication method is effective and practical.

articleTitle: Influence of environmental parameters on the prediction of thermoelectric generator energy generation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Thermoelectric generators (TEG) convert the thermal energy flowing through them into electrical energy in a quantity dependent on the temperature gradient across the thermocouple between the TEG ceramic substrates. Electrical outputs generated by the TEG shown on technical sheets provided by the manufacturer are usually a mismatch to the actual energy generated. This is due to the measurement methods, which are usually conducted under laboratory conditions, often omitting the environmental parameters that the TEG is or will be operating in. Hence the mismatch is of relevant importance to simulating the evolution of thermoelectric systems during thermal transients. In this paper, a finite volume method for three dimensional diffusions to derive the surface temperature on the TEG ceramic substrate is used in conjunction with the environmental parameters and construction material to predict the temperature gradient with high accuracy which will therefore reflect a more precise output voltage generated by the TEG.

articleTitle: Study of the influences of current limiting reactor on the circuit breaker breaking capability
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Northwest China is rich in energy resources including the renewable energy, therefore the power supply in some areas of the northwest power grid is in high density, which leads to the fact that the short-circuit current is too large and the series reactor might be used to suppress short circuit current. However, the series reactor application is also likely to leads to the slower decayed DC component and the higher DC component percentage in the total short circuit current and thus affect the actual breaking capability of the circuit breaker. Based on the probable practise of WB power grid, the impacts of series reactors on power system short-circuit current characteristics, especially the DC component and current zero offset are analyzed, and the breaking ability and making capability checking standard of circuit breaker are evaluated. Following conclusion are obtained: when the series reactor is installed to restrain the short circuit current, the breaking capability of the circuit breaker should be verified by the total short circuit current RMS.

articleTitle: Study on cleaning frequency of grid-connected PV modules based on Related Data Model
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To overcome the current limitations of cleaning frequency for grid-connected PV modules, this paper introduces this paper presents an effective approach to determine the cleaning frequency of grid-connected PV modules based on the structure, the establishing procedures and the dynamic updating method of Related Data Model. By calculating the coefficient of cleaning-tolerance of the photovoltaic power plants, the dynamic cleaning frequency is achieved and provides a quantitative basis whether to carry out the cleaning work. The research has a very important significance for improving the efficiency of photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: Dynamic reliability quantitative assessment of the relay protection system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a complete set of dynamic reliability quantitative assessment method which is applicable to any type of relay protection system. First, taking into account the comprehensiveness and representativeness, choose the reliability assessment indexes for relay protection system. Secondly, establish the dynamic fault tree model of the relay protection system reliability and transform the dynamic fault tree into a failure matrix to achieve a standard expression of the dynamic fault tree. On this basis, the quantitative assessment of the relay protection system reliability is realized using Monte Carlo simulation combining the dynamic fault tree and Markov chain. And finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified through the analysis of a practical example. The proposed method allows maintenance personnel to master the weaknesses of the relay protection system, and then take appropriate preventive maintenance measures. It is of great significance to the operation and maintenance of the system.

articleTitle: A new false root identification method based on two terminal fault location algorithm for high voltage transmission line
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High voltage transmission line fault location algorithm without synchronization, which does not require sampling synchronization, reduces cost and has a higher practical engineering value. But the algorithm still needs to be improved in the false root identification of ranging equation, this paper makes a further research on this issue. Firstly, the false root problem of fault location algorithm without synchronization is analyzed, and then a new false root identification method is proposed for the case that the traditional method can't be distinguished when the voltage amplitudes are close. The new method is based on the difference of the existence of the false root in the calculation of the voltage along the line with different electrical modulus. The proposed algorithm is simple, easy to solve and more universal. ATP-EMTP simulation results verify effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A kW-level high temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell stack and its cooling technique
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The study presents a kW-level high temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell and its cooling technique. The cooling method utilized internal cooling method to precisely control the temperature of stack. The temperature difference between the coldest and warmest measuring point is 7.3 K. In this study, we used two sealing methods for cooling mechanism in the HT-PEMFC stacks to demonstrate a simple and cheap sealing technique. The used sealing materials are specific silicone sealant and siliconelfluroeleastomer based O-ring. The coolant used in this study is triethylene glycol. The coolant flow rate is up to 60 LPM to stably raise the temperature of stack at 160°C within 600 seconds. The peak power density of the HT-PEMFC stack with proposed cooling/sealing technique can reach to 383mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Finally, a cooling design with the simple and cheap sealing technique can realize the request of cost-efficiency issues and improve the applicability of the HT -PEMFC stack technology.

articleTitle: A simple control method of open-circuit voltage for the FPGA-based solar array simulator
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar panels are widely used not only in terrestrial applications, but also are the main source of energy for spacecraft. The space solar array simulator (SSAS) for space power systems testing is generally used the linear power topology to deal with the power, because of its fast dynamic performance and good simulation accuracy. However, current-output linear power stage is very difficult to control the open-circuit voltage accurately, this paper presents a novel and simple open-circuit voltage controlled method with adding a dummy load of fixed resistance value paralleling output terminal of the FPGA-based space solar array simulator, and the digital controller give linear current source current reference with adding corresponding offset current reference, so that the flow of current through the dummy branch is controlled. By controlling the current value of the dummy load branch, it is easy to achieve precise control of the open circuit voltage in open condition. A prototype is built achieving the precision open-circuit voltage output in the range of 15 V to 60 V, with a 8.5 A peak output current and a 510 W peak output power. The experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain a good accuracy without influencing the high dynamic response of switching between short-circuit and open-circuit at 10 kHz.

articleTitle: New analysis method of accommodated capacity for wind power
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: While accurate measurement of wind power accommodation capacity is the foundation of wind power planning, power grid operation and dispatching scheduling. Based on the summary of existing wind power accommodated capacity evaluation methods, this paper presents a new method for evaluating wind power accommodated capacity. This method using the theory of production simulation, through 365 days of the starting balance and hourly power balance, reasonable arrangements for pumped storage operation mode, counted whole year accommodated wind power of electricity. Using this method of calculating whole year accommodated wind power of electricity number change in situation of different wind power installed capacity. It can determine a reasonable wind power of installed capacity. This method compared to conventional methods, can greatly improve the accuracy of the ability of wind power accepted, and can be flexibly applied to calculated wind power accommodated capacity in variety of economic performance indicators. Through practical example on a certain province's grid of the Northeast power grid to verify the accuracy of the new method, it has guiding means to power planning and improving wind power accommodated capacity.

articleTitle: The optimal sizing for AC/DC hybrid stand-alone microgrid based on energy dispatch strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The energy dispatch strategy of AC/DC hybrid stand-alone microgrid is put forward aiming at enhancing the operation economy of the microgrid. Based on the proposed energy dispatch strategy in this paper, an optimal sizing model is built with an economic objective. In addition, the environmental impacts are reduced to the objective function and the power supply reliability is added as constraints. By means of the modified artificial bee colony algorithm, the optimal sizing result of distributed energy in AC/DC hybrid stand-alone microgrid is obtained. Finally, the feasibility of energy dispatch strategy and optimization model is verified by example analysis. The optimal sizing result demonstrates that the energy dispatch strategy presented is more economical compared with traditional strategy.

articleTitle: Remote automatic switching and load shedding linkage control scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the local information traditional automatic switching develop the appropriate action strategy, and its action logic is fixed and can only accommodate a particular mode of operation. Because, using finite information about the grid makes it often cannot achieve optimal load restoration, even after the load transfer may causing overload, extending the fault , endangering the safety of the power grid. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a remote automatic switching and load shedding linkage control scheme. Based on the realization of the remote automatic switching, reserve capacity information is added to the substation communication. In the implementation of remote automatic switching, automatic switching combine with load shedding to make the load match the reserve capacity limit, to restore the maximized load, and ensure the safety and stability of the power grid, and effectively improve the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Simulation research of the unbalanced factor under the mutual influence of the multi voltage level quadruple-circuit sharing the same tower
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The electric unbalanced factor of a real quadruplecircuit transmission lines with 220 kV/ 1000 kV and 220 kV/ 500kV on the same tower in different sections is simulated by Electro-Magnetic Transient Program(EMTP). The simulation indicates that the current unbalanced factor of 220kV transmission lines is affected by the service conditions of 1000kV and 500kV lines, and that of 500kV transmission lines is also influenced by 1000kV transmission lines through 220kV lines. To reduce the electric unbalanced factor, the reverse phase sequence arrangement of double-circuit 220kV lines is recommended.

articleTitle: The safety analysis of live working on 500/220kV four-parallel lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With obvious economic and social benefits, fourparallel lines on the same tower is widely used and has high reliability requirements, the use of live working to carry out maintenance is particularly important. This paper takes 500/220kV four-parallel lines on the same tower as the research object. First, through the analysis of the risk of 500kV and 220kV line typical operation position, it can be found that the typical location operation risk is less than 1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>, and the workers can safely work. Secondly, the body surface field strength distribution of live working worker under the condition of equal potential is obtained by using the finite element method to calculate and analyze. The calculation shows that the strength of each part of the worker in 220 kV transmission line is obviously larger than that of 500kV lines, the strength of the worker's feet reachs a maximum of 2138kV/m, but the field strength inside the shielding clothes would be limited to the safe range when the workers put on shielding efficiency greater than 43.08dB. Therefore, by taking appropriate measures, the workers can safely carry out live working on the 500/220kV line.

Author Keywords: 500/220kV four-parallel lines on the same tower
surface electric field intensity of workers

articleTitle: Energy Hub modeling for minimal energy usage cost in residential areas
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Recently, the Energy Hub (EH) model which operates and optimizes the energy usage (electricity and heat) is mentioned in many studies. However, the model applied to sub-loading group in residential areas is not addressed in adequate way. Based on the characteristics and needs of energy used in practice, an EH modeling is proposed to solve the problem in residential areas. The optimization problem of energy usage cost is based on the demand of daily additional load and energy tariffs. In which, the objective function aims to minimize the energy usage cost considering power balance, energy tariffs, and capacity limits of the system. The calculation program is performed by General Algebraic Modeling System (GAMS) software. The effectiveness of the proposed model is evaluated through comparison with traditional energy supply model.

articleTitle: Source - Network - Load coordination planning study based on the big data from electric power metering
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The traditional power grid planning has been difficult to meet the safety requirements for more large-scale wind power system under the premise of admission requirements. Aiming at solving this problem and expecting to fully exploit information about output of wind power, we designed to achieve the quantitative risk analysis of wind power fluctuations. Based on this, we expected to establish a Source - Network - Load coordination planning model base on risk elimination for grid connection of large-scale wind power, and we applied bargaining game theory to find solution for the twin-goal model. Finally, a northwest region including wind power system was taken as an example to verify the correctness of the proposed coordinated planning approach.

articleTitle: Economic wind potential and effect of feed in tariff on installation in Turkey
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The excessive rises in energy prices and global warming have led countries on renewable resources. Turkey's (7.5 m/s and higher speed winds) terrestrial wind potential is 37,100 MW while offshore capacity is 10,013 MW. Approximately 75% of the wind potential is located in the Aegean and Marmara district and it offers many advantages such as, these are industrial cities and closed to consumption area, the land is suitable for the installation and all these offers advantages in terms of production and consumption. Turkey is targeted to supplied, 30% of the total energy from the renewable sources by 2023. In the meantime, 20% of the total electricity production is supplied from renewable sources in 2016. Turkey's wind potential and feed in tariff are investigated in a detailed way. In this context, regional and provincial assessable wind potential are discussed and quantitative and visual analyze are made. In addition, the state renewable energy incentive mechanisms are investigated on installation.

articleTitle: Load restoration optimization based on entropy weight method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Load restoration problem is a hybrid programming problem combining with the zero-one integer programming and the linear programming problem and has many safe constraints. It is the primary objective to maximize the load pickup through load priorities. This paper employs entropy weight method to evaluate load priorities. It concerns about the closely related indexes including load importance, load outage loss, load fluctuation and load reliability. By using the method, the objective weights (entropy weights) deduced from these indexes could be used in conjunction with the subjective weights acquired from knowledge and experience of experts. Obviously, this method can describe load priorities with more accurate results and overcome the defects of conventional methods that only use subjective weights. The optimum model of load restoration is set up and it can be transmitted to a 0-1 knapsack problem with one constraint through constraint relaxations. And hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed to solve the problem. The proposed methodology has been validated with the IEEE39 system.

articleTitle: Comparative study on PID Control and Fuzzy Control of motor speed of hydraulic transmission type wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With wind power generators of hydraulic transmission type as the research object, the mathematical model of the fixed displacement pump-double variable displacement motors speed regulating system, the permanent magnet synchronous generator and wind turbine were established aiming at the actual situation of hydraulic component in speed regulation circuit. The mathematical model of fixed displacement pump-double variable displacement motors speed regulating system was established through the AMESim. The mathematical model of permanent magnet synchronous generator and wind turbine were established through the MATLAB/Simulink. Respectively using the method of PlD Control and Fuzzy Control, the speed characteristics of hydraulic motor in VSCF wind power generation system were analyzed and compared. Research shows that the fixed displacement pump -double variable displacement motors speed regulating system can make the permanent magnet synchronous generator speed stability. The effect of Fuzzy Control is better than that of PID Control.

articleTitle: Dynamic optimization method for speed ratio of electric vehicle with two-speed transmission system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Currently, most of speed ratio optimizing methods for automotive transmission system belong to static optimization , while values of transmission ratio in the whole optimization process of velocity ratio are changing constantly. In order to obtain the best economic performance for the vehicle, corresponding gear- shift schedules should be adopted to different speed ratio. The paper has put forward a dynamic optimization method for speed ratio of the transmission system through analyzing deficiencies of static optimization method for speed ratio of transmission system. The method takes speed ratio of transmission system as design variable, and establishes objective function which considered lightweight design principles of transmission system. With ISIGHT-MATLAB/Simulink co-simulation optimization software platform and shift point judgment rules, it implementes dynamic optimization of speed ratio for transmission system, and has conducted comparative analysis on optimizing results simulated with static optimization method for speed ratio of transmission system. Ultimate optimizing results have indicated the correctness of the dynamic optimization for velocity ratio put forward in the paper as well as the correctness of considering lightweight design principle for the transmission system put forward in the paper.

Author Keywords: dynamic optimization method for speed ratio
lightweight design principle for the transmission system

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of heat transfer in natural draft dry cooling towers under crosswind using radiator-type windbreakers with heterogeneous distribution of water
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of crosswind on triple natural draft dry cooling towers is studied and analyzed. Concerning this area, many researches have concentrated on one cooling tower. This research focuses on the mutual effects of the adjacent towers' performance, and also makes a comparison between the efficiency of the three cooling towers in windy and no-wind conditions. Three dimensional governing equations with standard k-E model for turbulence are solved using finite volume method. In modeling the crosswind condition, at first radiator-type windbreakers with usual uniform distribution, and then radiator-type windbreakers with heterogeneous distribution of water are used for each cooling tower. Finally, the water outlet temperature of the radiators' cooling towers are analyzed, and the total heat rejections at different conditions are compared. Numerical results show that radiator-type windbreakers with heterogeneous distribution of water can substantially improve cooling efficiency more than uniform regime. It should be mentioned that a complete grid study is done to achieve a grid-independent solution.

Author Keywords: triple natural draft dry cooling towers

articleTitle: Optimization and operational management of renewable Goldwind Microgrid test bed
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Microgrid comprises of versatile type of alternate energy resources in order to distribute electricity economically, effectively and securely. In this study, the energy demand of Goldwind smart industrial park demand is forecasted and optimized based on daily load, wind and PV generation system using three techniques. PSO-NN, VAR for Forecasting and GA for optimization algorithm. The complete generation model consist of wind, PV, Vanadium redox flow Battery and Microturbine Generator. The system is based on an hourly operating cost to meet the electricity demand of a smart park located in Beijing. An objective relation is built by using all the constraints and then optimize the battery charging and discharging time as well as power trading between the utility and the Goldwind Microgrid test bed. The model is validated on the real time test window of approximately one month.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of tilt angle for photovoltaic arrays
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model is established by C language programming. The model is based on the KT method of calculating the average solar radiation on sloped surfaces which shows improved results over the isotropic method. The average solar radiation at different locations of China are calculated and compared with the results gained in previous research or by widely used commercial software for validation. The good agreement indicates that the model is suitable for calculating the amount of solar radiation and determining the optimum tilt angle. The monthly, seasonal and yearly optimum tilt angles are determined according to the monthly, seasonal and yearly maximum radiation respectively when the tilt angle changes. A new adjustment of changing seasonal tilt angle is presented. The solar radiation falling on the tilted surface is found to be enhanced as new seasonal adjustment is adopted. The results show the influence of tilt angle on the performance of photovoltaic projects.

articleTitle: Sensorless control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor based on rotating coordinate system considering dead-time
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Conventional Sliding Mode Observer (SMO) collects the rotor position angle information by identifying rotor position angle and needs to introduce phase-locked loop (PLL) to realize the reverse control. It has certain limitations including massive calculation, slow dynamic response and complex methods and not taking the effect from the inverter dead-time on the estimation model into consideration during the identifying process. To solve the problems, a new sensorless control method for the adaptive SMO based on rotating coordinate system considering dead-time is proposed. In this method response speed is improved by adopting rotating speed as control variable and phase error between actual motor and model motor is removed by introducing dead-time compensation in model motor.
