Then adaptive law of the estimated rotation speed is acquired through the Lyapunov non-liner design. It significantly simplifies the algorithm and can achieve reverse control at the same time. The effectiveness and feasibility have been proved by the results of the simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Fault current identification of DC traction power supply system based on LMD time-frequency entropy
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a method of identifying the short-circuit fault current in DC traction power supply system based on local mean decomposition (LMD) and time-frequency entropy is proposed. Firstly, the feeder current signal of DC traction power supply system is analyzed by means of LMD, by which the LMD time-frequency distribution can be obtained. Secondly, the LMD time-frequency plane is divided into time-frequency blocks with equal area. Finally, the time-frequency entropy of the time-frequency plane is obtained, which can serve as the feature vector to distinguish the oscillation current and the short-circuit fault current in DC traction power supply system. According to the simulation analysis, it can be found out that the simulation results conform to the theoretical analysis. Moreover, the calculation results of the measured data show that the proposed method is capable of distinguishing the oscillation current and the short-circuit fault current in DC traction power supply system.

articleTitle: Network reconfiguration for loss reduction in distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel algorithm of network reconfiguratoin based on improved quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO), which can be used for loss reduction in distribution network with distributed generation. First, the network topology is analysed on the basis of branch loop incidence matrix and layered branch incidence matrix. Second, calculate the network loss by layered forward-backward sweep method. Then, an improved QPSO is proposed where the disturbance factor is introduced, based on which the network reconfiguration is put forward. Finally, the proposed algorithm is proved to be effective by applying to PG&E69 bus system and the Tai-Power 11.4-kV distribution system.

articleTitle: Accurate modeling and sliding mode control method to improve the current sharing performance for PV grid-connected interleaved flyback mirco-inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper the overall fourth-order model of the CCM photovoltaic grid-connected interleaved flyback microinverter is established. The model can analyze the pole-zero locations under different power accurately and improve the control effect of low power. In addition, it is difficult to directly analyze the load imbalance caused by mismatched parameters of the two fly back circuits. In view of the above problem, a sliding mode controller is designed for the current sharing. The problem of load imbalance caused by different parameters of the two flyback is solved, and the output current is improved. A prototype of 250W PV micro-inverter has been built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed modeling and the control approach.

articleTitle: Research on application of oscillation location and control in large-scale power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In some cases, continuous small power disturbances can excite a low-frequency oscillation. Removal of disturbance source is the best way to rapidly damp the oscillation down. In this paper, a new method is proposed to locate disturbance source that is based on the space-time characteristics of low-frequency oscillation in the large-scale power grid. Meanwhile, a new principle for out-of-step oscillation center locating is also proposed, which is based on the angle difference of voltage phasors between both sides of the oscillation center. Then, a scheme of integrated oscillation control system for the large-scale power grid is designed, which has been tested by a detailed RTDS simulation and implemented in the actual engineering project. It is effective for both low-frequency and out-step oscillation.

articleTitle: An optimal control method of ice-storage air conditioning based on reducing direct cooling cost sequentially
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Among control methods for ice-storage air conditioning (IAC) optimal operation, methods based on intelligent optimization algorithms are complicated and short of feasibility. Common control methods in engineering are of low economic efficiency. In this paper, the minimizing daily operation cost is adopted as objective function, the capacities of operation patterns and ice storage capacity are taken as constraints, and thus the mathematical model of IAC optimal operation is formulated. Then, an optimal control method based on reducing sequentially direct cooling cost is proposed. Time for making and melting ice is arranged according to the order of electricity price and direct cooling cost respectively. Through several iterative calculations, an optimal solution is obtained. Compared with the results obtained by GAMS and common engineering control methods, the proposed method has good feasibility and economical efficiency.

articleTitle: Topology identification method based on multi-agent for outage areas in multi-contact distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distributed intelligent feeder automation (DIFA) can achieve the second level power recovery. However, it is difficult to obtain the topology information, when it applied to multi-contact distribution network. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a topology identification method based on multi-agent for outage area in distribution network. In the method, topology information is distributed in each intelligent terminal and the generation process contains three kinds of agents: internal topology publishing agent, external topology calling agent and topology generation agent, which complete the topology configuration of local intelligent terminal, topology acquisition of other intelligent terminal and topology concatenation of outage area. After the fault isolation in multi-contact distribution network, through the interaction between the three kinds of agents, the intelligent terminal generates the topology structure of outage area. The method has the advantages of clear logic and fast topology generation speed, which lay the foundation for the application of DIFA in multi-contact distribution network.

articleTitle: Yield prediction of photovoltaic power station based on the data of real-time I–V curve measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the influence of site location, module type, ambient temperature, solar radiation and other unpredictable factors, the yield prediction of photovoltaic (PV) power station is always very challenging. Nowadays, the traditional forecasting theory which uses Gaussian model and empirical parameters is most widely used. In this paper we propose a new prediction method which is based on real-time I-V measurement of PV Modules. Based on the measurement results, the power generation of the photovoltaic power station can be simply calculated by integrating the instantaneous maximum output power of PV module. Our analysis results reveal that this method is more accurate than the traditional one, because it considers the impact of real environment, such as cloud shading, orientation and degradation. Therefore, the method investigated in this study may be a promising and feasible way for the yield prediction of PV power station.

articleTitle: Research and design on variable load buck energy conservation controller for asynchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Asynchronous motor is vital for trades and occupations because of simple structure, the reliable running, the convenient service and cheap price. However, it is generally known that motor which is direct-on starting has many malpractices. When electrical machinery light-loading running, the power lose increases, the efficiency and power factors both reduce greatly. Therefore it has extremely vital significance to implement effective control on asynchronous motor, guarantee the security of the electrical machinery, and enable it running economically. This paper studies the principle if motor energy-saving in AC voltage regulator, then an energy convention controller with variable load has been implemented using phase control thyristor conduction angle control mode which can automatically track the load, save energy with light load and has various protective functions. In addition, it can realize the soft start function with small start current and mechanical shock in the process of motor starting, and achieves the purpose of a controller with a variety of control functions. The power saving rate is as high as 39% after the experiment on the friction pressure machine of 132KW1600T, and the energy conservation effect is obvious.

articleTitle: Optimal model of power purchase strategy for direct power purchase by large consumers based on the multi-state model of electricity price
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Direct power purchase by large consumers is a hot issue in electric system reform of the present stage. The reform of power market is steadily boosted which allows large consumers to participate in market competition directly. With the development of retail power market, large consumers can choose purchasing electric energy among spot market, longterm contract trade power market and autonomous power plant. The development of direct power purchase by large consumers helps to improve the electricity price formation mechanism and elevate the optimal configuration level of electrical resources, but large consumers need to face more uncertain factors of market in the specific process of power purchase. For purchasing combination of large consumers in electricity market, and comprehensively considering uncertainty of the power price, this paper analyzes the optimal combined electricity purchasing strategy of large consumers from the viewpoint of expected electricity purchasing cost. Taking the electricity purchasing of large consumers in market as research object, an optimal model of power purchase strategy for direct power purchase by large consumers based on the multi-state model of electricity price is put forward in this paper, and considering the chaos optimization theory, the solving algorithm is also presented to the complexion. It not only provides an optimal power purchase strategy for direct power purchase by large consumers, but also decreases the expected electricity purchasing cost.

Author Keywords: direct power purchase by large consumers

articleTitle: Research on dynamic heat transfer of a power-split hybrid electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Heat load is one of the most crucial problems of the hybrid electric vehicle research. In this paper, a thermal management system applied on a power-split hybrid electric vehicle is proposed. A dynamic heat transfer model of this system based on lumped parameter method is established. A whole vehicle driving cycle simulation is explored to evaluate the validity of the model. Simulation results show that the thermal management system applied to the power-split hybrid electric vehicle can fulfil the heat dissipation requirement of powertrain heat components under different driving conditions. The dynamic heat transfer model can be used to predict the dynamic response of the power-split hybrid electric vehicle heat source components effectively.

articleTitle: Response and emissions performance of diffusion combustion fueled with DME and natural gas blends
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Tests of component response on burner flame tube and furnace heat transfer and combustion performance of small industrial furnace bench are carried out by adjusting the proportion of dimethyl ether (DME) in natural gas. Results show that compared with pure nature gas, dimethyl ether mixed gas has the similar thermal efficiency and heating load, which states that mixed gas possesses the favorable interchangeability with natural gas. There is not big difference of pollutant emissions between blends and pure natural gas, with NOx emission keeping in a relatively low level. What's more, from economic view a ratio of dimethyl ether between 10% and 30% is advisable to improve combustion efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on early detection and identification of short circuit fault based on terminal voltage in low voltage distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Existing quick or early detection and identification methods for short fault are based on the sharp increase of the short current to extract the fault features in low-voltage system. They all have a technical bottleneck problem of miscarriage of justice, which is affected by the noise of the distribution system and the non-fault running state interference caused by different load starting or switching. On the basis of establishing the simulation model of the single-phase short in the low-voltage system, this paper analyzes waveforms of the faulty branches terminal voltage in full angle range and concludes the characteristic which faulty branches terminal voltage almost drops to zero at the moment of short circuit and remains near zero zone before fault elimination. And based on the above analysis, this paper introduces the wavelet packet decomposition method and combines wavelet packet decomposition method with instantaneous value of terminal voltage so as to eliminate the interference of noise and different types of load startup etc. Simulation and experimental not only verify the effectiveness and fast of the terminal voltage early detection method for short circuit but also solve the problem of the reliability of the existing methods for early detection of short circuit current.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic power system modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the model of photovoltaic panel is built by analyzing the variation of open circuit voltage and short circuit current caused by ambient temperature and radiation intensity fluctuation. Also the current-voltage and power-voltage curves in different radiation intensity and ambient temperature are showed. The influence of radiation intensity and ambient temperature variation for output current and voltage is analyzed, too. Two different maximum power point tracking strategies: P&O method and INC method are introduced and simulated. With the DC/DC boost circuit connected to the load, the PV system is operated in these two methods, respectively. The output voltage, current and power curve of PV and load are showed to prove the validity of these two methods.

articleTitle: Regulation of load rate of distribution network based on short-term load forecasting
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Load rate is an important indicator of local power supply and consumption and the research on load rate is significant for the development of low-carbon power grid. In this paper, an effective load regulation scheme for Shaanxi local power grid is presented. Using largest exponent algorithm, short-term load forecasting is conducted. Based on the prediction result, the influence of large scale cool storage air-conditioning and electric vehicle on load rate is analyzed through daily load curve superposition method. Finally, a load regulation scheme is put forward and simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Feeder topology representation method based on multiway tree
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Feeder topology representation method has an important impact on the research of distribution network. According to the structure of the feeder, this paper proposes a new representation method for feeder topology based on multiway tree. In the method, we take power, load, bus, and line in the feeder as nodes and take the switches as lines to connect the nodes to compose a multiway tree, which can represent feeder topology information. Switch state is important auxiliary information for multiway tree structure, and we use the two-dimensional array whose row number and column number both match the nodes number to store switches information between the nodes. The two-dimensional array establishes the one-to-one relationship between the line in the multiway tree and the actual switch. By the topology information and the control information, which is independent of each other, the method can not only describe the feeder structure completely, but also has the advantages of clear physical meaning, independent control elements and high access efficiency. It provides a new idea for the research on distribution network.

articleTitle: Economic comparison of distributed grid-connected photovoltaic generation with different business models
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distributed grid-connected photovoltaic generation as one kind of clean energy and developing PV industry is favorable. The distributed grid-connected photovoltaic generation in China mainly adapts the two business models including "Feed-in Tariffs" and "Self-Consumption". Currently, the national energy bureau reduces the standard feed-in tariffs, which brings certain influence on the profits of distributed grid-connected photovoltaic generation. This paper firstly adopted qualitative analysis to compare two business models from the three parties of interest including enterprise, grid company and users. Then, with the concrete example, for the economic benefit of business model, the paper used the index of dynamic evaluation approach including the net present value (NPV) and the internal rate of return (IRR) to evaluate it. It's concluded that the decline of government subsidies was even more unfavorable for the investment with "Feed-in Tariffs" model. And the higher the electricity consumption price is, the more advantage the "Self-Consumption" model has. Thus, for the investment in distributed grid-connected photovoltaic generation, it should comprehensively consider the local policies, local electricity price, rent, etc. to adjust measures to local conditions.

articleTitle: Experimental and numerical analysis of solar potential and feed in tariff in Turkey
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Turkey has high solar energy potential due to its geographical location compared to many other countries. In this paper Turkey's solar energy potential are analyzed and numerical calculation are conducted and obtained results are compared with experimental data to validate simulation accuracy. Average daily electricity production from PV system, average daily sum of global irradiation per square meter received by the modules are calculated and compared with experimental data collected between 1985 and 2006 by General Directorate of Turkish Meteorological Service. PVGIS program is used for numerical calculation and solar potential are calculated and compared for each region of Turkey. Also feed in tariff system are analyzed in terms of financial perspective, and discussed the related key issues and challenges for the feature. Turkey's average annual sunshine duration are measured 2640 hours (a total of 7.2 hours per day), and the average total solar radiation is calculated 1311 kWh/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-year (daily total of 3.6 kWh/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Southeastern Anatolia Region has maximum solar energy potential, followed by the Mediterranean Coast. After government new support scheme integrated into market by 2011, installation reached 442.13 MW.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of energy-saving control system of fan based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For the purpose of improving the operation efficiency and automatic control ability of fan, exploring energy saving potential at large and realizing full use of energy, the energy-saving control system of fan based on PLC S7-200 is presented. According to the variation of performance curve and pipeline characteristic curve under different flow regulating methods, the principle of energy-saving through frequency conversion control is investigated. The output voltage and frequency of variable frequency power supply can be adjusted in time on the basis of air flow pressure change so that it can keep fans' power input fluctuating in the high efficiency area. The frequency conversion of the boiler draught fan in a power plant indicates its energy-saving effect. Through a concrete example, the evaluation of frequency conversion is analyzed. The result shows that the system possesses high power-factor, auto constant pressure, and good reliability, so it has strong practicability and engineering application value.

articleTitle: Simplified algorithm of 3D-SVPWM in three level 3-phase 4-wire active power filter
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: 3D-SVPWM algorithm is used for synthesizing the desired bridge output voltage and generating compensation currents to cancel the harmonics. In this paper, depict the detail step for calculate the command vector and duty cycle of each leg in three level 3-phase 4-wire shunt active power filter system. After induction, proposed a simplified 3D-SVPWM algorithm. Compare to the traditional 3D-SVPWM algorithm, the proposed SVPWM algorithm simplified the operation, and shorten calculating time. Simulation and experimental results validate the correctness and feasibility of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-directional piezoelectric energy harvester with spring and magnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, with the efforts of worldwide researchers, harvesting energy from low-frequency vibrations has been realized. However, low-frequency vibrations usually come from various directions. So a piezoelectric energy harvester (PEH) can scavenge vibration energy from multi-directions with a simple structure is urgently needed. This paper proposes a piezoelectric elastic energy harvester consisting of a spring, a piezoelectric cantilever beam, a proof mass and two magnets scavenging multi-directional vibration energy with one cantilever beam. The piezoelectric cantilever beam and the spring are employed to sense vibrations from two orthogonal directions. The magnetic interaction is designed to transfer energy from the spring to the beam. In this paper, experimental study is carried out to verify the function of the multi-directional PEH. The experimental result indicates that the multi-directional energy harvester proposed in this paper is a high-performance way to harvest energy form two orthogonal directions.

articleTitle: Immunity requirements for secondary equipment with regard to switching operations of disconnectors in substations
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Switching operations of disconnectors in substations will give rise to a voltage and current damped oscillating wave on the busbars and produce electric and magnetic field simultaneously, which will coupled to the port of the monitoring and protection equipment at switchyard, affecting the performance of secondary equipment. This paper developed a measurement system, by which the characteristics of disturbance were obtained through field measurement in AIS and GIS substations with system voltage levels from 110kV to 1000kV. Based on the disturbance characteristics, the test levels of electrical fast transient (EFT), surge (impulse), damped oscillatory wave and damped oscillatory magnetic field immunity test are recommended.

articleTitle: Energy production from buoyancy-gravity forces effect on an object in a fluid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Nowadays it is necessary to develop alternative systems using renewable energies able to respond to consumer unpredictable demand. To this aim, present study explores the feasibility of energy production and/or storage from action of antagonistic buoyancy-gravity forces. The system is composed of an object immersed in a fluid which moves up and down, depending on overtaking of buoyancy or gravity force, and which transfers its kinetic energy to an associated mechanical or direct inductive system transforming object kinetic energy into electrical energy. System theoretical model has been parametrically developed to describe its behaviour and to calculate overall energy balance and response time. It is concluded that proposed system could be a viable system concerning energy issues.

articleTitle: Atmospheric icing of transmission line circular conductor bundles in triplex configuration
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Numerical study of atmospheric ice accretion on circular conductors in triplex configuration has been carried out at different operating and geometric conditions to get an understanding of ice accretion along conductors in triplex configuration and analyze the effects of changing distance between the conductors. The analysis were carried out for three different cases, where distance between circular conductors was changed (100, 200 & 400 mm) for each case. Results show that distance between circular conductors effects the flow and droplet behavior along each conductor that results in a significant change in ice growth and shape.

articleTitle: Research on index system and evaluating method of resources coordination capability of electricity purchasing and selling
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the case of electricity market reform, the electricity market is becoming increasingly active, and transacted electricity quantity is growing unceasingly and the tradable format is on the increase. Because of the limited energy resources, the level of transaction efficiency has become the focus of attention. In the face of resources diversity of electricity purchasing and selling, power grid carries out transaction under the purchasing and selling coordination which helps to optimize the allocation of transaction resources, improve resources utilization rate, and ensure power grid economy and stable operation. This paper studies the resource allocation levels in the power exchange, and establishes the evaluation index system of resources coordination capability of electricity purchasing and selling. The weight of index is determined by the combination of analytical hierarchy process and entropy weight method. Moreover, based on the gray correlation and TOPSIS method, the trade coordination capability of power grid is objectively evaluated. In the example, the related indicators are calculated based on actual data of the electricity market to get the key information of the purchase and sale integration, and then the information is evaluated synthetically. The effectiveness and correctness of the proposed evaluation system and synthetical evaluation method are validated by analysis on actual case.

Author Keywords: combination of analytical hierarchy process and entropy weight

articleTitle: Design of geothermal buried tube heat exchanger based on the double source heat pump systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar energy-soil source dual heat source heat pump heating and air conditioning system is a kind of energy-saving and environmental protection system. Heat transfer performance of buried tube heat exchanger and the reasonable design research is necessary for the core components of double source heat pump system. This paper expounds the design features of each part and the influence of factors of the geothermal buried tube heat exchanger. Heat transfer mathematical model is established and gives the design method, At the same time, the example of design calculation is given and compared with operation data and the analysis. The results show that the geothermal buried tube heat exchanger design is reasonable in this paper, the design data tallies well with the operation data, the calculation is simple and conform to the practical operation requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of lightning trip on transmission lines in Jiangsu power grid in 2015
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents some statistical analysis of lightning activity across Jiangsu province in 2015. Analyze trends of lightning times and geographical distributions. Combined with the data submitted by every unit and lightning location system recordings, analyze from multiple perspectives lightning trip times, trends, failure forms, lightning tower structural features, so grasp the reasons for all the lightning trips. This paper proposes lightning protection work from comprehensive lightning protection measures application, GIS system and lightning location system data arranging.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of hybrid heating based on electric heat-storage boilers and carbon crystal panels
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To improve comprehensive utilization of the electric heating equipment and profits of their operation, this paper mainly studies hybrid heating system. Aiming at the minimum investment recovery period and the maximum income of the heating system, this paper builds multiple target model by analyzing the main equipment cost, previous labor cost, operating labor cost and operating energy consumption cost of the electric heat-storage boiler and the carbon crystal panel, and applies particle swarm optimization to solve the two equipment' best configuration. By making exponential analysis of the office building heating scheme, we can figure that: In view of its investment recovery period being 2.4 years and cost saving rate being 35.1%, the heating scheme makes use of electric heat-storage boilers and carbon crystal panels has better economic benefits.

articleTitle: The research on control strategy of ships micro-grid inverter based on voltage compensation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Unbalanced grid voltage will influence output power and lead to output current deterioration in grid-connected operation of ships micro-grid. This paper introduces a new phase-locked loop and put forward an improved PQ control strategy. The phase-locked loop can detect grid voltage amplitude, phase compensation controller added to PQ control strategy in order to make sure voltage stability. Finally, this paper builds a grid-connected inverter model of ships microgrid in Matlab/simulink. The simulation results show that proposed method can suppress output power fluctuations and guarantee stable operation of sensitive load under unbalanced grid voltage.

articleTitle: Smooth transfer between the grid-connected mode and stand-alone mode in a marine shaft generation system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces a new concept of the shaft generation system applied in marine industry where both the grid-connected operation and the stand-alone operation are required. Detailed analysis of implementing these two modes and the smooth transfer between each other are given. Experiments are also carried out to validate the usefulness and practicality of the proposed control structure.

articleTitle: Application of field theory on the non-uniform thermal boundary condition analysis on a parabolic trough collectors
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Basing on field theory, the heat flux of solar trough collectors has been simulated in this paper. Basing on Illuminated Surface Theory, the ray transmission process from sun to concentrator surface has been simplified. It has greatly saved computing resources. The simulation results also have been compared with the result of the Monte Carlo ray tracing method and the data in reference at the same time. The result figured out that the simulation result basing on field theory is more accurate than the result basing on Monte Carlo ray tracing method and the result of field theory is closer to the data in reference. After that, the heat flux of LS-3 solar trough collectors has been simulated with different rim angle. The result showed that the heat flux distribution became more uniform and the max value became smaller when rim angle increased.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization strategy considering analytical impedance ratio with wind power
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, considering the traditional reactive power optimization cannot realize the continuous voltage adjustment and voltage stability, a dynamic reactive power optimization strategy is proposed in order to achieve both the minimization of network loss and high voltage stability with wind power. Due to the fact that wind power generation is fluctuant and uncertain, electrical equipments such as transformers and shunt capacitors may be operated frequently in order to achieve minimization of network loss, which affect the lives of these devices. In order to solve this problem, this paper introduces the derivation process of analytical impedance ratio based on Thevenin equivalent. Thus, the multiple objective function is proposed to minimize the network loss and analytical impedance ratio. Finally, taking the improved IEEE 33-bus distribution system as example, the result shows that the movement of voltage control equipment has been reduced and network loss increment is controlled at the same time, which proves the applicable value of this strategy.

articleTitle: Voltage level analysis for the scheme to put Laos Northern Grid into operation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, Lao grids are not yet interconnected over the whole nation. According to electrical connections, there are 3 parts: northern-middle grid, southern grid I, and southern grid II. This document analyzes voltage level of Laos Northern Grid in terms of the scheme of putting into operation, Laos Northern Grid line charging power compensating ratio is relatively low. At relatively light load, the HV reactor, LV reactor, and generator phase advance capability shall be made fu II use of to control the voltage.

articleTitle: Passive sun tracking of a single evacuated tube collector with the focusing mirror
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Evacuated tube solar collectors with a heat pipe is one of the most widely used solar collectors types. Although they are characterized by a very high energy conversion efficiency there are still possibilities for improvements. One of the available options is the use of mirrors focusing the solar radiation. In order to maximize the efficiency of absorbing solar energy with the focusing mirrors their manufacturers recommend the use of the tracking system for the apparent movement of the sun. Nevertheless, such a solution has several disadvantages which include: higher investment costs and energy consumption as well as potentially higher risk of faultiness. This paper presents the results of the experimental research, on the basis of which it was possible to determine the reduction of the radiation amplification factor in the case of system without solar tracking in comparison with the maximum theoretically attainable amplification factor. The research was conducted for a single evacuated tube collector with and without the focusing mirror. The parabolic focusing mirror, made of bent aluminum sheet, was selected for this analysis. As the result of these analyses the daily amplification factor was determined and this factor emphasizes the benefit of using the focusing mirror. Moreover, it was concluded that the amplification factor is insignificant when the solar hour angle is greater than 15° while azimuth of focusing mirror is direct south at the same time.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and model comparison of PMSG for power system transient stability studies
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the transient performance of wind turbines with direct-driven permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSGs) and compares PMSG models for power system transient stability studies. The control strategy of a PMSG is introduced firstly. Afterwards, the transient performance of a PMSG is analyzed in detail based on the PMSG's operating mechanism. To represent PMSGs in transient stability studies, different PMSG models are presented. A simulation case study is carried out to verify the PMSG performance analysis and to test PMSG models. The study results demonstrate that a PMSG does not possess the power angle characteristics of a conventional synchronous generator and can be seen as a controllable current source from the network viewpoint in the time scale of transient stability analysis. The controllable current source model of a PMSG has adequate accuracy in transient stability simulations. It can reduce simulation complexity and improve simulation speed compared with other PMSG models, especially in the scenarios with multiple wind farms.

articleTitle: Fast equivalent modeling of input series output parallel HVDC solid state transformer with LLC Structure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High-speed equivalent modeling is extremely important for the analysis of HVDC solid state transformer (HVDC-SST), including a large number of input series output parallel (' SOP) dual active bridge (DAB) units with LLC structure. This thesis presents an equivalent model-based method to largely simplify the model of HVDC-SST with described structure. According to the characteristics of HVDCSST with 'SOP structure, the fast equivalent modeling theory of LLC with DAB unit and the whole HVDC-SST is proposed out, and the specific circuit equivalent method is put forward. The discrete high frequency power supply is used to carry out the equivalent of the inverter; the series parallel connection of the branch circuit is equivalent to the part of the high frequency transformer, and the control current source is used to carry out the equivalence of the rectifier section. The DAB unit is simplified using the equivalent method, and the entire equipment is simplified with the brief DAB units. The experimental platform of 20kV/560V and the simulation platform of simulink are built to verify the consistency among the equivalent model, the original model and the actual waveform. By comparing the simulation time, the effectiveness of rapid equivalent modeling can be proven.

articleTitle: Harmonic loss quantitative model of transmission line considering the skin effect
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The use of nonlinear power electronic loads and new energy power generations make harmonic injection to the grid inevitable, lead to transmission line more additional harmonic losses and significant economic losses. Based on the mechanism of harmonic losses, this paper derived current density distribution formula for transmission line, a more precise calculation method of each harmonic resistance of transmission line is proposed, and this paper developed the calculating method of equivalent resistance of transmission lines in harmonic situation. In order to verify the effectiveness of the two proposed methods, the proposed methods were applied to IEC example to calculate harmonic loss. The results show that the proposed method can calculate harmonic loss more accurately.

articleTitle: Effects of wind conditions on heat dissipation from surfaces of walls for isolated low-rise building subject to winter solar radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Using a numerical simulation method which takes solar radiation into account, the process of heat transfer in a building envelope has been studied. The effects of wind direction and wind speed on the heat dissipation at the outside surfaces of an isolated low-rise building have been analyzed. The results show that the wind speed has a greater effect on the thermal energy dissipation flux at the outer surfaces of the building than the wind direction. The cumulative heat dissipation is at a maximum when the wall is perpendicular to the wind direction. Using binomial fitting equations relating the time-cumulative heat dissipation (which includes the convective and radiative heat exchanges), the heat dissipation coefficient for the outer wall surfaces, wind speed, and wind direction have been determined. These equations can be used as a theoretical basis to determine the air-conditioning load.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis and simulation of phase difference correction algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The paper presents a discrete spectrum analyzing method based on DFT, which can effectively reduce the phase error by choosing the window function with a real even function that has the linear phase spectrum. Since the traditional DFT algorithm could result in larger measurement error because of the spectral leakage and fence effect, the phase difference correction algorithm is proposed to cope with the problem. The simulation results indicate that the correction algorithm with Hanning window function can effectively improve the metering precision.

articleTitle: A pilot protection method of T-connected transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A pilot protection method of T-connected transmission lines is proposed in this paper. First, the startup information of each segment in three-terminal of T-connected transmission lines can be obtained. On this basis, the pilot protection fault identification criterion can be constructed. Then, according to this criterion, the fault position can be located quickly and accurately. This method simplifies the principle of setting coordination for distance I and II segment, without the effect of non-synchronous information. Finally, the simulation result from PSCAD (Power Systems Computer Aided Design) has proved the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A realization scheme of station area protection based on coordination method
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The substation is an important part of the grid system, intelligent substation has covered a wide range of characteristics of intelligent generalization, automation system operation, information utilization is the trend in the development of substation, but the Smart Substation in nature did not change the fundamental principle of relay protection, so there is still protective equipment tuning difficulties, limited range and protecting refused to move and misoperation of protection. In order to solve the above problems, the article discusses the characteristics and functions of the protection domain station, and the idea of the protection domain, specific research analysis the station protection domain control system with multiple levels of protection coordination and application of the key problem, put forward the scheme to improve the performance of system protection in Substation. The application scheme of the proposed station domain protection will be used for reference for the next generation of Smart Substation in the future.

articleTitle: Synchronous Buck DC-DC converter for ultrawide input-voltage range
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A power supply module using synchronous Buck circuit for ultrawide input-voltage range is proposed in this paper. In some renewable energy utilizations such as photovoltaic and geothermal power generation. The DC bus voltage of generator is substantial jump occasionally. A DC-DC power supply module which can work in the circumstance of ultra-wide input voltage range is developed, and output of module is characterized with low voltage and high current. Synchronous rectification is used in the main circuit, Quasi-resonant (QR) Zero Voltage Switching at switch turn-on (ZVS) mode is used in the auxiliary power supply circuit. Small signal AC model is established, active lead-lag compensation network is designed. A prototype with ultrawide input voltage range of 28–190V (1∶6.5), 24V/13A output, and rated power of 312W is fabricated to verify the effectiveness of the design and control method. The highest efficiency attainted is 95.1%, power density is 800W/kg.

articleTitle: Coordinated voltage control of synchronous condensers using wide-area measurements
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a coordinated voltage control of synchronous condensers using wide-area measurements. The control is able to determine a coordinated control scheme of synchronous condensers to maintain stable post-fault voltages. A voltage control model with synchronous condensers has been established using wide-area measurements. By applying Networked predictive control (NPC), the time delay of a wide-area measurement system (WAMS) is compensated, and then, the relation between predicted voltage deviations and a sequence of controls is derived. The solution to the voltage control problem is formulated as a quadratic programming (QP) over a finite horizon. Finally, the proposed coordinated voltage control scheme is obtained by repeated procedures involving prediction of voltage deviations, solution of the QP problem, and step-by-step feedback correction. The New England 39-Bus system is used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Economic analysis on the integration of oil-based parabolic trough solar collector and the steam turbine regenerative system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is a simple and efficient way to use new energy sources for the integrated power generation of oil-based parabolic trough solar collector and regenerative system of the coal-fired units. Under different test load conditions, the solar energy into the regenerative system was analyzed by the equivalent enthalpy drop method. The results showed that the heat entering the high pressure location was more significant than the economic improvement of low pressure. In the 210MW test condition, the maximum of the decrement coal consumption was 6.57 g/(kW.h). In addition, the relationship between the economic indexes, the working load and the heat of the solar energy were obtained when the heat enters a certain location.

articleTitle: Effect of new operation point correction unit for a PV generation system with different directional PV panels
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, authors propose a new method named "PV peak shift method", it adjusts the system to the maximum power point by shifting the maximum power point within the PCS input operating voltage. A developed prototype plug in operating point correction unit is installed between the photovoltaic (PV) panels and the PCS. This prototype unit has a configuration of a buck-boost type DC-DC converter. The P&O method operates at a lower peak point voltage when there are two peaks in the P-V curve. To overcome this issue, in the present study the proposed unit outputs the P-V characteristics that indicates higher peak point voltage. The result shows, after applying the PV peak shift method, the PCS is able to operate at the maximum power point even in cases of different directional PV panels placement. Furthermore in this experiment the generated power has increased about 1.47 time as compared with the conventional P&O method and, the effectiveness of the prototype unit is proved.

articleTitle: Research on the costs analysis of several kinds of heating equipments based on whole life cycle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the environmental pollution becoming more and more serious, it is a critical problem to choose appropriate clean coal-fired boilers alternative equipment. Among these problems, heating costs calculation is the top priority which has not formed a unified standard. According to the concept of whole life cycle costs and based on the consideration of environmental benefits, the costs of heating equipment are classified and the heating equipment cost model is built in this paper. By analyzing energies of electric, gas and coal, the best coal-fired boilers alternative equipment can be found out. Taking Liaoning Province as an example, a comprehensive analysis of the costs of several kinds of heating equipment is conducted, and the best local coal-fired boilers alternative equipment is obtained, so as to promote further application and popularization of electric heating equipment. At last, the feasibility of the method of cost calculation is verified.

articleTitle: Study on wind power integration optimization model suitable for multi-operation mode
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In day-ahead and real-time phases, due to limited regulation generation resources to satisfy operation reserve requirement, it is difficult to guarantee clean energy integration in full, and the integration capacity of power grid to clean energy could not be fully realized. Meanwhile, in the monthly and long-term operational planning phase, on the basis of power plant annual plans and future trend analysis for electricity, there are more generation resource optimization tools. Through different time cycle, power generation and transmission resources coordination optimization, the level of integration for clean energy can be improved. In this article, optimization periods and power-power conversion method are analyzed. The wind power integration optimization model for the three operations modes "clean energy full integration, system run cost minimum, SAN-GONG progress deviation minimum" are respectively established. Based on sequential multi-objective optimization method, the wind power monthly integration optimization model that gives consideration to multi-operation mode is proposed. The proposed model was tested on a real system; the results obtained demonstrate the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Aggregation model of air-conditioning load demand response to adapt the wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large-scale wind power penetration impacts the power system in many aspects and raises a number of technical challenges for system dispatch and control. Coordination and optimization of limited conventional power generation resources is difficult to cope with the increasing wind power capacity. The coordinated interaction of 'source-grid-Ioad' is an important means to promote the wind power integration and the future direction of smart grid. As an important demand response resource, air-conditioning load of residents can improve the utilization of wind power through participating optimization dispatch. Based on the thermal dynamics model of an air-conditioning unit, this paper discusses the parameters affecting the working status and proposes the aggregation method considering parameter differences using the Monte Carlo simulation tool. The control strategies of load aggregator are presented to maximize the aggregation capacity of residents air-conditioning loads. Then the optimization dispatch model including load aggregator is proposed to adapt the wind power integration. At last, the validity of the proposed approach has been verified using the IEEE 10 bus test systems.

articleTitle: Influence of potential well depth on the dynamic characteristics of the bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the progress of MEMS technology, the vibration energy harvesting technology based on environment vibration has become the hot topics of the nonlinear dynamic study. The bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester (BEVEH) with an auxiliary linear oscillator is studied in the paper. Influence of the potential well depth on the dynamic characteristics of the bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester is researched in the paper by simulation. The relationship curves of the potential well depth and the stiffness ratio are obtained. It can be concluded that with the stiffness ratio increased, the depth of the potential well become shallower. The power generation with the deep potential well is much more than that with the shallow potential well. The relationship curve of the power generation of the BEVEH system and the depth of the potential well under the different excitation frequency is obtained. It can be concluded that the power generation with deep potential well is more than that with shallow potential well. And there is an optimal depth of the potential well when the BEVEH system works well under some frequency range.

articleTitle: Rotor dynamics research of the composite flywheel spin test system: Modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The strength study of composite flywheel is an necessary part for flywheel energy storage technology. The drive and bearing technology are the key challenges for a high vacuum and high-speed spin test device. The dynamics of the flywheel rotor-bearing-damper directly determines whether the flywheel can be accelerated to the test speed and runs stably. For these reasons, a flywheel spin test system with small stiffness lower support but no upper support was established. By means of the Lagrangian equation, the dynamic model of the flywheel rotor-bearing-damper was built to calculate critical speeds, modal shapes and modal damping ratios with different speed. The supports' function and their effects on the modal damping ratios and forced vibration were also discussed. The results show that the spin test system without the upper support is simple, efficient and runs stably at the high speed.

articleTitle: A new research of fault selection based on active protection
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The small current grounding system has many problems: low ability of extinguishing arc grounding and personal sense of electric system, none security and protection ability to indirect grounding overvoltage, equipment internal fault grounding, the new type of fault line selection method in this paper based on active protection can effectively solve the above problems. This article first introduces the significance of active protection to the quick arc suppression and personal protection, then puts forward a new kind of line selection method based on active protection and introduces its principle, finally, through research in the small current grounding system of single-phase grounding fault which is in different transition resistance, initial Angle and fault distance by using wavelet transform and PSCAD software simulation, the effectiveness of the active protection of line selection and accuracy is verified.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of micro-grids power supply based on operating modes
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The reasonable capacity configuration of distributed generation in a micro-grid is the prerequisite of its reliable and economical operation. This paper establishes a optimal configuration model of micro grid power supply aiming to reach the goal of the optimal comprehensive benefits of micro grid, and then solve the configuration model by using particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on single phase two-level grid-connected photovoltaic power generation system based on Boost circuit MPPT control
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At first, this paper describes topology of single phase two-level grid-connected photovoltaic power generation system. And then, this paper analyzes the operational principle of Boost-circuit. At last, the optimal control method is presented based on MPPT control, and the Matlab/Simulink proves the feasibility of the whole system.

articleTitle: Analysis on interactive influences among control loops of multi inverters connected to weak-structured power system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Long-distance power transmission and the increasing number of grid-connected inverters make multi inverters grid-connected power network equivalent impedance non-ignorable under the weak-structured power system. The existence of power network equivalent impedance couples multiple inverters in PCC, and then causes the complex interactive influences among control loops of multi inverters grid-connected system. The equivalent model of multi inverters connected to weak-structured power system was established, dynamic relative gain array based on frequency was used to quantitative analysis the interactive influences among control loops of multi inverters and give interactive change characteristics with the changing grid-connected inverter units, control parameters and power grid equivalent impedance. Finally, a multi inverters grid-connected was built in Simulink simulation platform, the correctness of simulation results were verified. Meanwhile, general rules of changing interactive influences among control loops with the increasing number of inverters grid-connected were accurate descripted.

articleTitle: Study on the establishment of the steam-turbine generator unit shafting entity model
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing of the steam-turbine generator unit shafting structure's size, the phenomenon of the shafting's torsional vibration gets worse. Torsional vibration will produces safety problem and leads to the economic losses. By the way finite element analysis is a kind of method to study torsional vibration, however shafting model is the basis of the finite element analysis. So a flexible method of establishment shafting entity model seems to be very important. This paper mainly studies three methods of conventional modeling, cluster table parameterized modeling and APDL language programming modeling for this problem, which can implement parametric modeling. And this paper compares these three methods from easy, rapidly and reusability to find a flexible establishment method and provide a reference for finite element analysts.

articleTitle: Research on control algorithm of high voltage circuit breaker three phase permanent magnet brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the high voltage circuit breaker three-phase permanent magnet brushless DC motor, this paper studies the motion characteristics of the motor operating mechanism under different control strategies. Considering the switching operation process of high voltage circuit breaker, we established the permanent magnet brushless DC motor operating mechanism motion simulation model of the control system. It was controlled by the digital double closed loop and the inner is current loop, where a PI controller is adopted. The outer ring is speed ring, which was controlled by two different control strategies, the traditional PID controller and single neuron PID controller. Through the simulation analysis of servo control system, the tracking control performance of the motor operating mechanism is obtained. The results show that the single neuron PID controller can achieve better tracking control of the contact speed, making it moving by the ideal motion characteristic curve. It is an ideal and effective control method.

articleTitle: Research on Synchrophasor computing based on massive COMTRADE data
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Variety of transducers of power grid such as, digital fault recorder(DFR), phasor measurement unit (PMU), power quality monitor records the operating state with different frequency. In order to exchange data, a standard data exchange format, COMTRADE, is employed. Full-wave Fourier algorithm was adopted to calculate the synchronized phasor (synchrophasor) and frequency spectrum leakage as a consequence of frequency deviation was studied in the paper. For reducing the computation load, recursive Discrete Fourier Transform (RDFT) was adopted and the calculation time of RDFT and DFT was shown in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of PLC based reclosing device on synchronization line of small hydropower stations
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The traditional auto-reclosing method in relaying cannot meet the requirements of the distribution network with small hydropower in case of faults. In order to provide reliable guarantee for safe operation of transmission line, on the basis of the improvement measures by the reclosing device in the practical engineering, a reclosing device adapted to synchronization line of small hydropower station is designed and implemented in this paper. SIEMENS PLC-1200 is used and the human-computer interface is realized by WinCC monitoring configuration software. Field application result indicates that the device improves the success rate of reclosing and promotes reliability and stability of power supply in small-hydroelectric area.

articleTitle: Analysis of the energy savings of Power Supply Scheme in Premium Power Park
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Premium power park (PPP) provides corresponding power supply for different levels of load using multiple PQDs, which is an effective measures to solve power quality problem. Existing international and regional or national power quality standards was given firstly. Then according to Premium Power Park user's feature, from the power supply capacity, load-sensitive, power quality level requirements etc, designed real-time monitoring systems for power quality, custom power and energy storage device's distribution program, function and performance indicators. To study energy saving of PPP operating with power supply scheme adding PQDs, and satisfy limits of power quality, proposed a an energy saving quantization to meet the Premium Power Park and various user needs. The calculation model show that under the new power supply scheme, energy loss of line and transformer have decreased and supply efficiency of system has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Study on design and operation characteristics of dual-source heat pump system of solar collectors
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the actual engineering, the paper designs and calculates the selection, direction angle and the tilt angle of the collector, and on this basis to establish a mathematical model of solar collectors on sunny days. The article simulates and analyzes the heat transfer characteristics of All-glass vacuum tube solar collectors on typical sunny days. Through the comparative analyzing the curve of the analog value and the engineering value of the collector outlet temperature, the conclusion is that the trend of the analog value and the engineering value are consistency. The overall margin of error does not exceed 5°C. This model can be used to predict changes in sunny solar thermal collector system outlet water temperature.

articleTitle: A new method for node ranking for voltage stability in power systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a new method to rank nodes in power systems in terms of how close the loads at those nodes are to the limit that the system can supply before voltage collapse occurs. This method is applicable to slow load fluctuation and static modeling is used. The method is based on the fact that the Jacobian Matrix becomes singular at the voltage collapse point. This paper focuses on calculating the maximum load margin at load buses before reaching voltage collapse gradually (static voltage instability). After get the limit of bus load, the load bus could be ranked.

articleTitle: Transmission path optimization method combining sensitivity analysis with breadth first search theory suitable for large scale direct electricity trade
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large direct power consumers not only can stimulate the power market potential but also can be a breakthrough in the reform of the market. The Research is about transmission path of the direct power purchase, which support the stability analysis of power grid operation and branch block management. This paper will propose a sensitivity analysis method based on breadth first search, the breadth first search method can search out all transmission paths, the combination of the breadth first search method and the sensitivity analysis can recreate the superposed sensitivity. For this purpose IEEE 118 bus system has been used as example and the results will show how useful and effective this method can be.

Author Keywords: large consumers direct purchase of electricity

articleTitle: Power and Load Unbalance protection modeling and parameter optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power and Load Unbalance protection (PLU protection) is one of major turbine protections to preventing steam turbine overs peed. The start condition is that if unbalance of mechanical power and electrical power exceeds the limitation, the PLU protection will be actuated to close the valves but not stop the generators. But the accidents have happened and power grid simulation show that the grid faults may make the PLU protection false trip, that maybe turn the valves on and off frequently, seriously, it may even create power oscillation. In order to solve this problem, the generator rotating speed constraint is introduced into the PLU protection and the simulation model is established in this paper. The setting method of rotating speed constraint parameter is proposed. The simulation results verify that this method can effectively prevent the PLU false trip and improve the reliability of PLU protection.

articleTitle: Research on application of run-of-river small Hydropower Station group short-term power forecast system in Guizhou Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is analyzed the requirements of run-of-river small hydropower station group (RSHSG) short-term power forecast in this thesis. And the functions of short-term power forecast system is detailedly described from the software structure. Finally, selecting the data from April.2016 and May.2016, the application effectiveness of system is analyzed by comparing the accuracy both in time and space scale. The successful application of system in Guizhou Power Grid, has great significance in improving management level of grid dispatch and safe operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Research of regional electricity integrated resource strategy planning layout under new situation: Based on the perspective of Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Facing with the increasingly tight resources and environmental constraints, according to the characteristics of Henan Province region, resources and demand, this paper constructed the Henan 6 interregional area grid transmission line of electricity and power constraints, in order to research regional resources overall optimization path of Henan province, and established the Henan province integrated resource strategic planning model(HNIRSP)which took the cross-regional transmission in multi area into account and conducted the scene simulation analysis on electricity power layout of the power integrated resource planning in Henan Province. The scenario analysis of the Henan Province integrated resource strategic planning model shows as follows: getting rid of the efficiency power plant(EPP), the total of new power demand in Henan province in 2014–2030 is about 96950MW, which reduces the installed capacity about 32250MW compared with the results of the space balance situation. In a word, it can directly reduce the investment of the whole society about 10.86 billion yuan, and reduce the emissions of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> about 11627 million tons, and reduce the emissions of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> about 37.7 million tons and reduce the emissions of NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> about 32.8 million tons.

articleTitle: Investigation on the applicability of 10 kv cold and heat shrinkable cable accessories in hot and humid South China
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: 10kV cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cables are widely used in power system because of its advantages of small external influence factors and high reliability and safety. However, cable accessories are weak links of the cable lines. Considering the hot and humid environment in Guangzhou areas, the applicability of cold and hot shrinkable cable accessories is questionable. This paper has carried out the research on the applicability of two kinds of cable accessories. Firstly the cable accessories operating and common faults were researched and analyzed. Secondly the defect simulation is carried out, including four kinds of conditions: (1) the main insulation with air gap, (2) the main insulation with impurities, (3) the connecting pipe with burr, (4) semi conductive layer uneven. Also the situation of electric field distortion is analyzed. Then the experiment and analysis is done to investigate the cable accessories materials affected by hydrothermal environment, mainly focusing on the electrical performance and sealing performance. Finally the research on the cable accessories installation technology and specification in Guangzhou area is carried out, and the cold and hot shrinkable cable accessories installation suggestions are recommended. The heat shrinkable accessories in the southern humid areas are not very suitable.

articleTitle: Capturing cosmic rays using surface wave technologies
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Cosmic rays are high energy particles travelling at near the speed of light. Unlike electromagnetic waves, they are subjected to the influence of magnetic field. Being small in size, some of these particles can penetrate through certain low-density metals with no ionization at all. Some of the cosmic particles will bombard with the atoms in the metal, forming positive ions. Aluminum and silver are low-density metals having surface plasmon resonant frequencies right at the ultraviolet band. If one of these metals is chosen to capture cosmic energy, a large portion of the cosmic particles can pass through the metal without doing any work. This means capturing a cosmic energy into a DC will not be efficient if aluminum or silver are used to capture cosmic energy. In this paper, we propose a novel cosmic energy receiver which can cost-effectively capture cosmic energy into a DC without running this problem. To prove its feasibility, experimental prototypes have been built and their load voltages have been measured in the absence of any sunlight.

articleTitle: Research on the moving contact characteristics detection technology of high voltage circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High voltage circuit breaker is the main electrical equipment of the power system, which performance is directly related to the operation of the power grid. On the basis of researching on the influence of the high voltage circuit breaker and the moving speed of the moving contact on the moving characteristics, the moving characteristics and signal processing circuit of high voltage circuit breaker are designed. We analyzed the influence of moving speed of high voltage circuit breaker moving contact on the vacuum arc extinguishing chamber life first, and then according to the high voltage circuit breaker travel and processor features, the detection of moving contacts movement features and signal processing circuit were designed. Finally, based on the existing mine 40.5kV high voltage circuit breaker, the experimental system is built, and the design of the circuit test is completed.

articleTitle: Designing and simulating for research of filtering of direct current transmission system based on novel converter transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The characteristic to shield harmonics of the novel converter transformers is presented in this paper. Then design the DC transmission system of the novel transformer to achieve harmonics shielding function, by adopting the novel transformer on the rectifier side. Based on the calculation method of harmonic content in the HVDC system, calculate and allocate the reactive power compensation on both the rectifier side and inverter side on the experiment platform, according to which a variety of filters parameters are designed. Final, simulation to DC transmission system is carried on, and the result indicates that the harmonics shielding function can be achieved using the novel converter transformers, which has certain value in use in the engineering.

articleTitle: Installation height analysis of Ф-type vertical axis wind turbine on the flat building
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, we simulate the wind environment of a flat building without wind turbine by using FLUENT software. From the perspective of turbulence intensity and wind speed ratio, the wind turbine's install heights of front edge, middle and back edge at flattened building are determined; and then wind turbines are installed at the forefront of building to simulate the flattened building wind environment. In the case of considering the front wind turbine producing wake, the installation height of middle and back edge wind turbine will be further explored. The best position and arrangement of wind turbines on the flat buildings were also discussed. What's more, the utilization efficiency can be analyzed.

articleTitle: Effect of control parameters on infliction of sub-synchronous control interaction in DFIGs
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This research work deals with the analysis of sub-synchronous control interaction (SSCI) in doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs). The time-invariant model of the DFIG is linearized to perform eigenvalue analysis and to obtain the participation factor of each state variable for unstable modes. The sensitivity of system eigenvalues related to sub-synchronous modes is analyzed with respect to all the proportional and integral parameters of the controllers in the rotor-side-converters and grid-side-converters. The major contribution of this research work is the outcomes based on eigenvalue analysis that clearly point out the control parameters to which sub-synchronous modes are highly sensitive. The effect of series compensation level on DFIG system and on the sensitivity of converter control parameters is also studied.

articleTitle: A novel model for home energy management system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the environment of smart grid, residential users play an extremely key to improve the efficiency of the power grid. It is necessary to motivate residential users to participate in managing their household appliances. However, it is a considerable challenge for residential users to find an optimal scheduling scheme of household appliances by themselves. In this paper, a novel model for home energy management system (HEMS) based on Internet of things (loT) is proposed to solve this challenge. The model not only utilizes radio frequency technology (RFID) to achieve full automatic control of household appliances, but also employs renewable energy, storage battery and plug-in electric vehicles (PEV). Considering various users' demands, the model can set four kinds of demands for household appliances via terminal appliances.
